audit.whatIsWrong: The entry's answer to level 6 is "his attack-speed spike starts out-DPSing your sustain". It never mentions that Highlander makes him immune to slows.
audit.why: Riot's text: "Master Yi moves with unparalleled agility, temporarily increasing his Move Speed and Attack Speed as well as making him immune to all slowing effects." Tahm Kench's entire kiting and disengage plan runs on Tongue Lash's slow — the kit flags it as his slow tool — and during Highlander it does nothing at all. But slow immunity is not CC immunity: the three-stack Tongue Lash stun and Abyssal Dive's knockup both still land. A player told only "his DPS ramps" will keep throwing a slow that has been switched off, instead of holding stacks for the stun.
audit.corrected: Highlander (85s) makes him immune to every slowing effect — Tongue Lash's slow stops working. The three-stack stun and Abyssal Dive's knockup still land, so those are your only tools while it is up.
sources: champ-data/_kits/masteryi.json — Highlander, cooldown 85; champ-data/_kits/tahmkench.json — kitFlags slow: Q, R

audit.whatIsWrong: Meditate is never mentioned in the entry, in any form.
audit.why: _missing-interactions.json states it directly: "Master Yi's Meditate (W) is a channel — your Tongue Lash (Q) cancels it outright." Riot's text confirms it restores health, reduces damage taken, and pauses the remaining duration on Wuju Style and Highlander while channelling. It is on a flat 10s. That makes Tongue Lash a hard counter to his only sustain button, on a cooldown short enough to matter every wave — and it is the reason a Tahm Kench beats him in an extended lane. Absent entirely.
audit.corrected: Meditate is a channel on a flat 10s. Tongue Lash cancels it outright. It also pauses Highlander's remaining duration, so a Yi who meditates mid-ultimate is banking time you should not give him.

audit.whatIsWrong: Alpha Strike's untargetable window is never mentioned, despite the entry telling you to "stun him mid-reset".
audit.why: Alpha Strike "teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed... while simultaneously becoming untargetable", on 20/19.5/19/18.5/18s reduced by his basic attacks. Devour is point-and-click, so spending it as he Alpha Strikes throws the ultimate away for nothing. _missing-interactions.json flags this as untargetable-dodges-burst. Its 600 range against Tongue Lash's 900 is also worth stating — you out-range his only gap-closer.
audit.corrected: Alpha Strike goes untargetable for the dash and reaches 600 against your 900. Never cast Devour into it — wait for him to land.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry calls his damage "his shred" three times (spikes[3], whys[5], whys[6]) without ever saying what it is, and gives no itemization guidance.
audit.why: Wuju Style "grants bonus true damage on basic attacks" on a 14s cooldown — _missing-interactions.json flags it as resistances-invalidated. Against true damage, armour is worthless; only maximum health and Thick Skin's conversion scale. That is a concrete build instruction (Heartsteel over armour items) that the vague word "shred" hides. Separately, Meditate is flagged needs-antiheal, so Grievous Wounds is what wins the item race the entry describes as "skill-decided".
audit.corrected: Wuju Style is true damage on his autos — armour does nothing, so stack HP. Meditate heals on a flat 10s, so Grievous Wounds decides the first-item race.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0], whys[0] and `early` all describe a "Q slow-stun" available at level 1, and spikes[1]/whys[1] describe "three-stack Q poke" at level 2.
audit.why: Tongue Lash only stuns a target that already carries three An Acquired Taste stacks — "If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed." At level 1, with Q on a 7s cooldown and no prior damage, there is no stun available; Q applies a stack and a slow. Calling it a slow-stun makes a player commit to a level-1 all-in on lockdown they do not have.
audit.corrected: At level 1 Tongue Lash is a slow that applies one stack. Build the other two with autos first. The stun exists only when three stacks are already on him — and firing it consumes the three stacks that Devour needs.
sources: champ-data/_kits/tahmkench.json — An Acquired Taste, Tongue Lash cooldown 7 at rank 1

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet-flagged: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, and the entry names none of Master Yi's abilities.
audit.why: Not one number appears in the whole entry. The ones that decide the lane are Meditate at a flat 10s, Wuju Style at a flat 14s, Alpha Strike at 20s at rank 1 (shortened by his basic attacks), and Highlander at 85s. Highlander also "passively reduces cooldown for his other abilities on a kill or assist", so a Yi who gets a takedown is running a different set of numbers.
audit.corrected: Meditate flat 10s. Wuju Style flat 14s. Alpha Strike 20s at rank 1, reduced by his autos. Highlander 85s, and takedowns cut his other cooldowns.

audit.why: `late` says to "swallow the damage meant for your carry", which is correct — Devour on an ally shields them ("shielding them if they are an ally"). Left alone.
